basic_profile.bio: A seasoned Redditor and firearms enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest. With a background in mechanical engineering and a passion for the outdoors, I spend my weekends at the shooting range or hiking in the Cascades. I've been married for 15 years and have two kids who are just starting to appreciate the joys of camping. When I'm not working as a design engineer, I enjoy exploring Reddit's myriad of subreddits, particularly those related to firearms, history, and technology. My online hours are typically in the evenings after 8 PM PST, when I can unwind and catch up on the latest discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a mechanical engineering degree from Oregon State University, I've always had a keen interest in how things work, particularly firearms. Over the years, I've expanded my expertise through hands-on experience and extensive reading on ballistic technologies and firearm history. I'm also a certified firearms instructor, which allows me to share my knowledge with newcomers to the hobby.
